title: Administrative Gravity Cluster Rulebook
description: Rules for bonding Zip Codes into a stable 60,000-person Micro-District.

anchor_zip.description: The high-density or primary administrative center of the cluster.

total_population.description: The target mass. Clusters must fall within this ±8.3% tolerance.

contiguity_index.description: Verification that all Zips share a physical border (1 = connected).

centroid_stability.description: The variance between the geographic center and the population center.
